day.title: A day from the lodge door
day.lead: Nobody comes to Sharm to sit in the room. This is what is waiting outside it.
day.amB: El Hadaba stands above the Ras Um Sid reef, and the dive centre is minutes from the door. A mask and fins, and the Red Sea does the rest.
day.pmB: Come back when the sun is at its strongest. The pool is in the middle of the lodge, with umbrellas and sunbeds around it and your room two steps away.
day.eveB: El Hadaba's restaurants are a walk away, and the Old Market and Al Sahaba mosque are at their best after sunset.
day.tripsT: Ras Mohammed National Park and Tiran Island: boat trips leave Sharm every morning.
day.airport: Sharm El Sheikh International Airport is 15.6 km by car.
